lines.text: و صورت دیگر دب اکبر است بیست و هفت کوکبست و خارج آن صورت هفت
lines.en: And another constellation is Ursa Major, it is twenty-seven stars, and outside that constellation are seven

lines.text: کوکبست انرا بنات النعش کبری خوانند چهار بر بدن اوست و سه بر دنب و انرا که
lines.en: stars, they call it the Greater Daughters of the Bier (Ursa Major), four are on its body and three on the tail, and the one that

lines.text: بر طرف دنب اوست قاید خوانند و انرا که بدو نزدیکست عناق خوانند و اندیگر
lines.en: is at the end of its tail they call al-Qa'id (Alkaid), and the one that is near it they call 'Anaq (Mizar), and the other

lines.text: که برسم دنب اوست حقیر خوانند و به نزدیک عناق کوکبی خرد است و انرا سها
lines.en: that is on the root of its tail they call Haqir (Alioth), and near 'Anaq is a small star and they call it Suha (Alcor),

lines.text: خوانند و صورت دیگر شجاع است بیست و یکستاره است و صورت ماری نقش
lines.en: and another constellation is Hydra, it is twenty-one stars, and the figure of a snake is drawn

lines.text: و صورت دیگر قنطاورس است و انرا ملتهب خوانند و یازده کوکب است دو تا
lines.en: And another constellation is Centaurus, and they call it the Inflamed, and it is eleven stars, two

lines.text: او با کوکبی دیگر بشکل مثلثی بزرگ صورت دیگر عوا است و انرا صیاح و عوا
lines.en: of them with another star in the shape of a large triangle. Another constellation is Boötes, and they call it the Shouter and Boötes,

lines.text: السما خوانند و صورت مردی ایستاده و دستها کشاده و کوکب او بیست و
lines.en: al-Sama, and the figure of a man standing and hands spread, and its stars are twenty and

lines.text: دو است و خارج صورت یکی است در میان دو پای او او را سماک رامح
lines.en: two, and outside the constellation is one between his two feet, they call it Spica (Arcturus),

lines.text: خوانند و از ان کوکبها است که در قدر اول باشد و صورت دیگر فکه است و
lines.en: and it is of those stars that are of the first magnitude. And another constellation is Corona Borealis, and

lines.text: انرا کلیل شمالی خوانند و عامه مردم کاسه سکینان خوانند و در پندار استاد
lines.en: they call it the Northern Crown, and the common people call it the Beggars' Bowl, and in the belief of the master

lines.text: وضعه افتاده است بر مثال کاسه شکسته و ستارگان این صورت هشت اند دیگر
lines.en: its position has fallen like a broken bowl, and the stars of this constellation are eight, another

lines.text: جاثی علی الرکبه است بر مثال مردی بزانو در آمده و ستارگان او بیست و نه و خارج ان سه
lines.en: is Hercules (the Kneeler), like a man fallen on his knees, and its stars are twenty-nine, and outside it three.

lines.text: صورت یکی است و صورت دیگر حوا است در اینی و سحاف خوانند و کوکب او دهند و از
lines.en: The constellation is one. And another constellation is Ophiuchus, in this they call it the Serpent-bearer, and its stars are ten, and of

lines.text: این جمله کوکبی است از قدر اول و انرا نسر واقع گویند و عوام سه پایه و دیگ پایه
lines.en: this whole is a star of the first magnitude, and they call it Vega, and the common people call it the Tripod and the Pot-stand,

lines.text: خوانند و صورت دیگر دجاجه و طایر خوانند هفده کوکب است و خارج صورت دو کوکب
lines.en: And another constellation they call Cygnus and the Flyer, it is seventeen stars, and outside the constellation two stars,

lines.text: است و از جمله کواکب اینصورت کوکبیست روشن از قدر دوم و انرا دنب الدجاجه
lines.en: and of the whole of the stars of this constellation is a bright star of the second magnitude, and they call it Deneb,

lines.text: و صورت دیگر ذات الکرسی خوانند سیزده کوکب است و این صورت زنی است بر کرسی
lines.en: And another constellation they call Cassiopeia, it is thirteen stars, and this constellation is a woman on a chair

lines.text: نشسته و پاها فرو گذاشته و کوکب روشنی است از قدر ثالث و انرا کف الخضیب
lines.en: sitting and legs let down, and it is a bright star of the third magnitude, and they call it Caph (the Dyed Hand)

for someone who is asked something and he
gives another answer. And Suha is an extremely
small star and is next to 'Anaq, and people

summary.headline: Constellations and Named Stars
summary.text: Descriptions of constellations in an anonymous judicial-astrology manual, including Ursa Major, Hydra, Centaurus, Boötes, Corona Borealis, Hercules, Ophiuchus, Cygnus, and Cassiopeia, with star counts, figures, aliases, and notable stars such as Alkaid, Mizar, Alioth, Alcor, Arcturus, Vega, Deneb, and Caph. Marginal material discusses the faint star Suha/Alcor, the Beggars’ Bowl and bier imagery, and associated constellation figures.
